about.heading: About Nihira
paragraphs: Nihira is undoubtedly a remarkable talent in the world of contemporary music, blending her classical training with a deep appreciation for poetry to create a unique and emotive musical experience. Her dedication to conveying emotions through her compositions is evident in the heartfelt resonance of her work.

Based primarily in India, she has the opportunity to engage in collaborative projects with artists from diverse backgrounds, which undoubtedly enriches her musical journey and broadens her artistic horizons.

Her accolades, including the Clef Awards for ‘Trishna’, the State Award Nomination for ‘Whats Up Lagna’, and the nomination at the 18th Independent Music Awards (USA) for ‘Nirmohiya’, serve as a testament to her exceptional contributions to the music industry. These recognitions are a testament to her ability to touch the hearts of her listeners and her skill in bringing out the true essence of words through her music.

Nihira’s ‘word-centric’ and ’emotion-centric’ approach to music sets her apart, allowing her compositions to resonate deeply with those who have the pleasure of experiencing them. With her impressive background and continued dedication to her craft, it’s clear that Nihira will continue to make significant strides in the realm of light music for years to come and ears to come.
